answer: Someone running 172 aliases as a result needs 41 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in vertex, expire in river, and onyx lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1727 identities would post 1839 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
